text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Team morale had distinctly risen thanks
to 
a hard-fought practice match.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two scouting members of Team First 
worried that just doing what Acting 
President Kashimoto told them would 
eventually lead to defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If they're doing it for friendship, then 
we'll do it for Acting Director Kashimoto—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Acting Director Kashimoto happened to
spot 
the members of Team <First> engaging in
unplanned 
training.
